signature.one_line: Song-driven hiring reel told through props (screen, paper signs), logo bug, 3D zoom-blur logo sting.
unique_devices: All messaging diegetic: the headline is on a laptop screen lifted to camera, roles on printed paper signs, the contact on a sheet pushed into the lens; zero typed overlays
Physical reveal hook: a chair facing away spins round and the laptop is lifted to camera on the song's first hit, then a push-in onto the screen
Closing logo sting on white: extruded logo pieces streak in with a radial zoom-blur and rotate into place over ~53 frames, then hold (~28 % of runtime)
Small white logo-mark bug top-right on every footage shot
signature.why_it_works: Props feel authentic and office-native; the chair-spin reveal is a tiny mystery synced to the music; the sting brands the ending without any copy.

hook.first_frame: Office chair facing away in front of a colourful branded wall, wide and static; small white logo mark top-right

structure.what: Chair spins round, employee lifts the laptop to camera showing the hiring headline
Push-in on the laptop screen, employee smiles
Second employee behind monitors holds up a paper sign listing 3 roles
Staff at a glass door with a sign of 2 more roles; a printed 'send your CV to' sheet slid into close view
3D logo zoom-blur reveal on white, then hold

background_text.how: White logo mark (no text), top-right, x 79.3-90.4 % (~11 % W), y 5.9-11.3 %; static from frame 0, cut with the footage

motion_graphics.how: Hard cut to white; extruded logo pieces streak in with a radial zoom-blur and rotate into place over ~53 frames (ease-out, power3.out), fully settled ~75 frames after the cut, then near-static hold to the end; logo centred x 19-80 %, y 41-60 % (centre ~52 % H)

cards_lists.how: 2-3 role lines per A4 sheet, held up or taped to glass, one sign per shot (~60-210 frames); the contact sheet is pushed close to the lens for ~60 frames

broll_inserts.how: Headline slide on the screen (dark geometric sans on accent, key word bold italic) filling ~62 % of W at ~47 % H

layout.how: Wide seated subject ~15 %, laptop insert ~12 %, handheld sign shots ~45 %

camera.what: Static wide for the chair-spin reveal
camera.how: Locked, subject centred in front of the brand wall
Soft push over ~10 frames (detected as a soft transition), lands on the screen
Phone handheld on signs and the door, walk/follow

transitions.how: 3 hard cuts timed to the song phrases (not on detected onsets: cut_hit_share 0.0)

end_card.how: White background, full logo artwork (mark + wordmark + small spaced caps line) in the brand colour; zoom-blur streak-in then hold

other_text_spec.text: laptop screen headline (dark geometric sans on a blue screen, key word bold italic) filling ~62 % of W at ~47 % H in the screen shot; printed A4 role sheets and a 'send your CV to' + contact sheet held to camera. Reproduce on real props, not as overlays.

layout.anchor: top-right, ~9.6 % from the right edge, ~6 % from the top

other_text_spec.animation: static, on from frame 0, cut with the footage

wordmark.note: use the client's own logo file, not typed text

animation.entry: hard cut to white; extruded 3D logo pieces streak in with a radial zoom-blur and rotate into place from frame ~2 to ~53 after the cut, ease-out, settled by ~frame 75
animation.idle: near-static hold for the remaining ~80 frames

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, cool: office fluorescent with a cool white/blue cast, saturated brand-wall colours, clean white end card

sound.music: trending pop song with vocals at full level, no voiceover (speech_coverage 0.12 is the sung hook); beat periodicity 0.61, ~122 bpm estimate; steady (loudness range 1.7 LU)
sfx: none; hard cuts follow song phrases, not detected onsets (cut_hit_share 0.0)
optional: whoosh/impact under the logo zoom-blur reveal

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Music-Led Montage with Minimal Dialogue
catalog_styles.role: song carries the piece; no voice

use_when: the user can shoot a few staged office moments with props (screen, printed signs)
the message is a hiring call or announcement with a short list and a contact
the brand has a logo file suitable for a 3D/zoom-blur sting
no one wants to speak on camera; a song carries it
avoid_when: viewers must read longer details (paper signs are small on a phone)
the platform needs captions or a spoken explanation
a long static end card would hurt retention (shorten the sting to ~15 % of runtime)
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B41 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B41.json) to this brand.
This blueprint has NO captions and NO typed text overlays: the message lives on props in the footage (screen headline, printed signs). Only a logo bug and a logo sting are added. Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} bug must stay >= 3:1 on the top-right of every shot; {{ACCENT}} logo >= 4.5:1 on {{SURFACE}})
- {{TEXT}}: logo-mark bug colour, default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}: end-card logo colour, default #264378
- {{ACCENT_2}}: unused, default none
- {{SURFACE}}: end-card background, default #FFFFFF
- {{CARD_BG}}: unused, default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: prop-screen headline (made as a slide on the laptop, not overlaid), default Poppins 600 with the key word Poppins 800 slanted
- {{FONT_BODY}}: printed signs, any bold sans, default Poppins 700
- {{HANDLE}}: contact on the printed sheet (email / "@handle")
- {{LOGO}}: logo mark for the bug + full logo file for the sting

CAPTIONS
1. None. Do not caption song lyrics; add no typed overlays.

OTHER TEXT
2. Logo bug on every footage shot: {{LOGO}} mark in {{TEXT}}, top-right, x 79.3-90.4 % (~11 % W), y 5.9-11.3 %; static from frame 0 until the end card.
3. End card (last ~28 % of runtime): hard cut to {{SURFACE}}; full {{LOGO}} in {{ACCENT}} centred at x 19-80 %, y 41-60 % (centre ~52 % H). Reveal: logo pieces streak and rotate in with a radial zoom-blur over ~53 frames (power3.out), fully settled ~75 frames after the cut, then hold still to the end.

EDIT
4. Hook (~15 %): static wide, chair facing away in front of a branded wall spins round; the subject lifts a laptop to camera showing the headline on the music's first hit.
5. ~15 %: soft push-in onto the laptop screen (headline fills ~62 % W at ~47 % H, key word bold italic).
6. 28-72 %: handheld shots of staff holding/taping printed signs (2-3 role lines each, one sign per shot, ~60-210 frames per shot); finish with the contact sheet ({{HANDLE}}) pushed close to the lens for ~60 frames. 3 hard cuts timed to song phrases.

SOUND: one trending song with vocals at full level, no voiceover; optional whoosh under the zoom-blur reveal. Master to about -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, cool office light with saturated brand-wall colour and a clean white end card.

VERIFY before rendering: snapshot one footage frame and one settled end-card frame. Measure the bug with
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_footage> --box 0.75,0.03,0.95,0.14 --ink "#FFFFFF:40"
(box x 79.3-90.4 %, y 5.9-11.3 % within +-1 %), and the end-card logo with --box 0.1,0.3,0.9,0.7 --ink "<{{ACCENT}}>:60" (centre ~52 % H, spanning x 19-80 %). No other overlaid text may appear.
